verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents registrable outbound webhooks: your endpoint receives a POST when a payment, payout or other account event happens, and webhooks can be simulated in the sandbox with test keys. None of the story's reliability features are evidenced: no signature verification, no automatic retries, no event logs and no replay. missing for 10: signed webhook deliveries (signature/secret hash verification), automatic retry policy, webhook event logs, manual or automatic replay/resend, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: Receive a POST request from Flutterwave when a payment, payout, or other event happens on your account.
Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox
